mapper.sql: id, ticket_no, charger_id, station_id, alarm_id, title, content, source, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance_ticket (ticket_no, charger_id, station_id, alarm_id, title, content, source, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{chargerId}, #{stationId}, #{alarmId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{source}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.ticket_no, t.charger_id, t.station_id, t.alarm_id, t.title, t.content, t.source, t.status, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_user, t.update_user FROM maintenance_ticket t JOIN charger_alarm a ON a.id = t.alarm_id WHERE a.alarm_code = #{alarmCode} AND t.status = 2 ORDER BY t.update_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
